items.title: CVE-2026-48907: Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla remote code execution in editor profile management (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla has a flaw that lets an attacker create new editor profiles, upload PHP code, and run it on the server, and this can be done remotely without logging in. The vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, which means it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-34197: Apache ActiveMQ Broker remote code execution in Jolokia MBeans (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache ActiveMQ (including the Broker and All packages) lets an attacker who can log in with a low-privilege account run arbitrary code on the broker's Java process. They reach it remotely over the network through the web console's Jolokia endpoint, by making the broker load a remote Spring XML configuration. This bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities c...

items.title: CVE-2023-32315: Openfire authentication bypass in admin console via path traversal (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openfire, an XMPP server from igniterealtime, has a flaw in its web-based Admin Console that lets an attacker bypass authentication and reach restricted administrator pages by using path traversal through the setup environment. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2022-0185: Linux kernel privilege escalation via heap overflow in filesystem parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A heap buffer overflow in the Linux kernel's filesystem context handling lets a local attacker escalate privileges to root, and container escape has also been reported. The attacker reaches it locally by opening a filesystem that falls back to legacy handling, and attacks using this flaw are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-1096: Google Chrome memory corruption in V8 via type confusion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has a type confusion flaw in its V8 engine that an attacker can reach remotely, without logging in, by getting a user to open a crafted HTML page. This can corrupt memory, and the related advisory says the worst of the bundled Chromium issues could allow remote code execution; attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-0847: Linux kernel root privilege escalation in pipe buffer handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Linux kernel's pipe handling leaves a pipe buffer setting uninitialized, so a local attacker with a low-privilege account can overwrite data in read-only files through the page cache and escalate privileges to root, for example by injecting code into root processes. Attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Exploited: Abandoned Idunno.AntiCsrf library opens legacy ASP.NET apps to RCE (CVE-2026-131914)
items.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: CVE-2026-132224, an Optimizely Web Experimentation vulnerability attackers leveraged to plant malicious JavaScript on high-profile websites; a Drupal core remote code execution bug (CVE-2026-132165); and CVE-2026-131914, a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Idunno AntiCsrf, a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library. CVE-2026-131914 exploitation detected ASP.NET is a server-side web-application framework used for building dynamic web sites, apps and se…

items.title: Cisco Expressway RCE (CVE-2026-76466) Exploited for Root Access
items.summary: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-76466, a critical Cisco Expressway flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers root command execution on clustered devices. In the first public case, they moved from two internet-facing nodes into the internal network, and CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on November 20, 2026. What Is CVE-2026-76466? CVE-2026-76466 is […]

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf remote code execution in ASP.NET CSRF token validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. The Idunno AntiCsrf software for ASP.NET unsafely deserializes untrusted data during its double-submit cookie and form field validation. A remote attacker can exploit this through object injection to execute code, without logging in over the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-133335
items.summary: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via controller fallback in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.7 - The main controller of the component fell back to including a controller file derived from the request without filtering the name, allowing path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files. Depending on the server setup, for example an available pearcmd.php, this could be used to execute code. The issue has been exploited in the wild. Fixed in 4.8.8.

items.title: Drupal Fail2Install Exploit Details Emerge as Critical RCE Flaw Faces Active Exploitation
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical flaw impacting Drupal to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring federal agencies to apply the fixes by November 27, 2026. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-132165 aka Fail2Install (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of remote code execution (RCE) impacting Drupal core. "Drupal Core

items.title: CVE-2019-15107: Remote command execution in password change page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Webmin has a command injection flaw in its password change page (the "old" parameter in password_change.cgi) that lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the server with root privileges. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and attacks are happening because the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
items.summary: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday. [...]

items.title: Exploit for CVE-2026-136412
items.summary: Proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2026-136412. CVSS 9.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-119618: Apache HTTP Server remote code execution in mod_http2 via race condition (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module has a race condition in its assign_headers() routine that can corrupt heap memory. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can exploit it to run arbitrary commands on the server, take control of the server process, and access or modify sensitive information. Public exploit code exists for this flaw.

items.title: CVE-2019-17382: Zabbix authentication bypass in dashboard page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix has a flaw that lets a remote attacker bypass the login page without logging in, then create dashboards, reports, screens, or maps. Other users and administrators can then access these items. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2015-10141: Xdebug unauthenticated command injection in remote debugger (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Xdebug, a PHP debugging extension, has an unauthenticated command injection flaw in its remote debugger, which listens on port 9000 when remote debugging is enabled. A remote attacker without a login can send a crafted eval command to run arbitrary PHP code, including system commands, gaining full control of the host with the web server user's privileges, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-24061: GNU Inetutils remote authentication bypass in telnetd (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The telnetd service in GNU Inetutils can be tricked into logging an attacker in as root without a password, because it passes an unchecked USER value to the login program, which treats it as a command option. An attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, by connecting to a reachable telnetd server. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-23131: Zabbix Frontend authentication bypass in SAML session storage (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix Frontend is affected when SAML single sign-on is enabled, which is not the default setup. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, change the session data, and gain admin access, as long as they know a valid Zabbix username or the guest account is enabled. It is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2022-22963: Spring Cloud Function remote code execution in SpEL routing expressions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Function's routing functionality is affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code and access local resources by sending a specially crafted SpEL routing expression, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks using this bug are happening.

items.title: CVE-2022-29464: Remote code execution through unrestricted file upload (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Several WSO2 products, including API Manager, Identity Server, and Enterprise Integrator, let an attacker upload any file, such as a malicious JSP, to a location of their choice on the server and run code on it. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in, by sending a crafted request to the /fileupload endpoint. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and att...

items.title: CVE-2022-26318: Unauthenticated code execution in network appliance (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances running Fireware OS have a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the device, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2017-12615

Description: By design, you are not allowed to upload JSP files via the PUT method on the Apache Tomcat servers. This is likely a security measure to prevent an attacker from uploading a JSP shell and gaining remote code execution on the server. However, due to the insufficient checks, an attacker could gain remote code execution on 7.0.0 to 79 Tomcat servers that has enabled PUT by requesting PU…

items.summary: CVE-2020-25042-PoC Proof-of-concept for CVE-2020-25042, an authenticated arbitrary file upload issue in Mara CMS 7.5 that can lead to remote code execution. The script logs in with a valid Mara CMS admin/manager account, uploads a PHP payload through codebase/handler.php, and executes commands through the uploaded file. It also reuses an existing shell when possible, so you do not create a new PHP file on every run. What It Does 1. Checks whether the expected shell already exists and is reusable. 2. If reusable, executes the command directly. 3. If not reusable, loads a CMS page and extracts s…

items.title: blankspace
items.summary: Blank Space Blank Space is a refactoring of James Forshaw's original proof of concept for CVE-2021-43893, EFSRPC arbitrary file upload privilege escalation. Blank Space can create arbitrary files on a remote host that is using unconstrained delegation if it isn't patched for CVE-2021-43893. File creation is done using the privileges of the remote user, so code execution is a bit speculative but defintely a possibility. Blank Space can also be used to begin a relay attack even after CVE-2021-43893 has been patched. Similarly, admin users can overwrite existing files, although that arguably does…

items.title: CVE-2026-132694 | Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 OATHAuth src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php privilege escalation
items.summary: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical , has been found in Wikimedia MediaWiki up to 1.46.2/1.47 . This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file src/Key/WebAuthnKey.php of the component OATHAuth . This manipulation causes privilege escalation. The identification of this vulnerability is CVE-2026-132694 . It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. There is no exploit available. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.summary: Attackers have been exploiting CVE-2026-132165, a flaw that lets them take over unpatched Drupal sites without logging in, since at least November 19, the Drupal Security Team has warned. Drupal is a free and open-source web content management system used by government agencies, universities, media outlets and large enterprises. The vulnerability is one of three that the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Tuesday, and federal … More → The post Critical Drupal installer flaw under active attack (CVE-2026-132165) app…

items.title: CVE-2026-134401: Google Chrome remote code execution in Variations (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has an input validation flaw in its Variations component. A remote attacker could use a specially crafted HTML page to potentially run arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2017-9841: PHPUnit remote code execution in eval-stdin.php script (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHPUnit, a widely used testing framework for PHP, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker can remotely run arbitrary PHP code on a server if its vendor folder is publicly accessible, potentially giving them full control of the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2024-36401: GeoServer remote code execution in property name evaluation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GeoServer, the open source server for sharing and editing geospatial data, has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending crafted request parameters, remotely and without logging in. It affects default installations through web requests such as WFS, WMS and WPS calls, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2017-12615: Apache Tomcat remote code execution via file upload in default servlet (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, a widely used web server for Java applications, is affected when run on Windows with HTTP PUT requests enabled. An attacker could upload a malicious JSP file through a specially crafted request, allowing the attacker's code to run on the server.

items.title: CVE-2012-1823: PHP remote code execution in the CGI binary (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The PHP interpreter when run as a CGI program (php-cgi) is affected, along with any web server setup that uses it to handle requests. An attacker who sends a specially crafted request with command-line options in the query string could run arbitrary code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2014-6271: Remote code execution in environment variable parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GNU Bash, the common Linux and Unix command shell, runs extra commands hidden after a function definition in an environment variable's value. A remote attacker can use this to run shell commands and take over a system, without logging in, whenever a service such as an SSH, web server CGI or DHCP client setup passes attacker-controlled environment variables to Bash. This flaw is listed as exploi...

items.title: CVE-2024-27198: JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass in server login allows admin actions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. JetBrains TeamCity has an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker perform administrator actions on the server. It can be exploited remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2018-14847: Unauthenticated file read in WinBox interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. MikroTik RouterOS has a directory traversal flaw in its WinBox interface that lets an attacker connect to the Winbox port remotely, without logging in, and read the system user database file, which exposes router credentials including plain text passwords. CISA lists this bug as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24086: Adobe Magento Commerce remote code execution in checkout input validation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Adobe Commerce (Magento Commerce) has an input validation flaw in its checkout process that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2023-43208: Unauthenticated code execution via command injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect has a flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server remotely, without logging in, which could be used to gain initial access or to compromise sensitive healthcare data. On Windows the code typically runs with the highest system privileges, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-20699: Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware unauthenticated remote code execution in HTTP server (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware, used on RV160, RV260, RV340 and RV345 routers, has vulnerabilities that let a remote attacker run arbitrary code with root privileges on the router by sending crafted HTTP requests, without logging in. Attacks using these flaws are happening, and exploitation is most relevant for RV340 and RV345 routers acting as an SSL VPN gateway.

items.title: CVE-2022-22954: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager remote code execution via server-side template injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager have a server-side template injection flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22965: Spring remote code execution via data binding (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Framework applications using Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux on JDK 9 or later can be taken over through data binding, letting an attacker run code on the application server remotely without logging in. The known exploit needs a non-default setup, with the app deployed as a WAR on Tomcat rather than as a Spring Boot executable jar, and attacks are happening, since the bug is listed in CISA'...

items.title: CVE-2022-24112: Apache APISIX auth bypass in batch-requests plugin via X-REAL-IP (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache APISIX, through its batch-requests plugin, lets an attacker overwrite the client IP header and bypass the Admin API IP restriction, which in a default setup with the default API key leads to remote code execution; otherwise the data panel IP restriction can still be bypassed. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24990: Unauthenticated remote code execution in web interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. TerraMaster NAS devices are affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code on the device, such as uploading a PHP webshell, by abusing PHP object instantiation. It can be reached remotely without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21882: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32k (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Win32k component of Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server (including Windows Server 2019 and 2022) lets an attacker gain higher privileges than they should have. The attacker must already be able to run code on the machine with a low-privilege account, and this flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21999: Microsoft privilege escalation in print spooler service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Windows Print Spooler service on several Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server releases lets an attacker raise their privileges to take much greater control of the system. The attacker must already have a low-privileged account on the machine, and no action from another user is needed. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0995: Linux kernel privilege escalation via watch_queue out-of-bounds write (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's watch_queue event notification subsystem has an out-of-bounds memory write flaw that can overwrite kernel state, letting an attacker gain privileged access or crash the system. It is reached locally by someone who already has a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation attacker code injection in account signup flow (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Optimizely Web Experimentation mishandles its account signup flow, which lets an attacker place their own code in the projectJS (Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets. An attacker can exploit this remotely over the network with a low-privilege account, and no action from a user is needed.

items.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. A low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive data or functionality. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: CVE-2026-16666 | mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 Image Swap loader.c boot_swap_image swap_size out-of-bounds
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 . It has been classified as problematic . This affects the function boot_swap_image of the file boot/bootutil/src/loader.c of the component Image Swap . Performing a manipulation of the argument swap_size results in out-of-bounds read. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-16666 . The attack is only possible with local access. There is not any exploit available.

items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Guardrail Sandbox Escape RCE
items.summary: What is the Vulnerability? CVE-2026-40217 is a critical arbitrary-code-execution vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM, a widely used open-source LLM proxy/gateway. LiteLLM's guardrail feature includes a "test custom code" facility that runs user-supplied guardrail code in a sandbox. The sandbox can be escaped by rewriting Python bytecode, allowing an attacker to break out and execute arbitrary code in the context of the LiteLLM process (reported running as root in some deployments). items.summary: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. items.title: CVE-2026-136455
items.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.title: CVE-2026-136241
items.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

items.title: CVE-2022-21971: Microsoft Windows code execution in WinRT (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in Microsoft's Windows Runtime, which affects several Windows 10 and Windows Server releases, lets an attacker run code of their choosing on the affected system. The attacker needs local access but no login, and a user must take some action, such as opening something, to trigger it. Public exploit code exists and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22947: Spring Cloud Gateway remote code injection in actuator endpoint (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Gateway is vulnerable to code injection that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending a crafted request, without logging in. This only works with a non-default setup in which the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured, and public exploit code exists (including a Metasploit module) and attacks are happening.

items.summary: What is the Vulnerability? CVE-2026-90436 is a critical unsafe-reflection vulnerability (CWE-470) in Apache Axis 1.x, the legacy SOAP web-services library. items.title: CVE-2026-80273
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and privilege escalation, resulting in complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-136706
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in the DIGIT Platform due to improper neutralization of user supplied input while constructing SQL queries and execution in the affected User and Access Control Service components. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted input through the affected API endpoint to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially resulting in unauthorized disclosure, modification or deletion of database information on the targeted system.

items.title: CVE-2026-129968
items.summary: LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop does not verify authenticity of "pd" parameter and uses it to render a template without checking that it is a real .tpl file. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted requests to a store that cause the server to process attacker-suplied content, potentially giving the attacker full control of the store and access to customer and payment data. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-128857
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the source URL, destination path or file type when an unauthenticated AJAX action fetches a file and writes it to a web-accessible directory, allowing unauthenticated users to upload executable PHP files and achieve remote code execution, as well as read arbitrary local files.

items.title: CVE-2026-128854
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate URLs taken from the request before fetching them server-side and returning the response, allowing unauthenticated users to make the server request internal resources and read the responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115280
items.summary: The Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 does not perform authorisation checks when rendering its front-end print document for a reserved order identifier, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the configured store contact details (including the site administrator's email address) and to create Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 files in arbitrary existing, writable directories outside the Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0's own folder.

items.title: CVE-2026-134630
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Perl Modules (cpan) module, which downloads CPAN indexes and module archives over plaintext HTTP without checksum or signature verification. On-path network attackers can answer the outbound fetch while an administrator installs a CPAN module, supplying a malicious Makefile.PL that cpan/download.cgi runs as root before confirmation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134643
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136631
items.summary: Mastodon 4.7.4 and 4.8.0-alpha.3 before 5.0.0-beta.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in authenticate_with_sign_in_token that allows authenticated local users to rebind pending login attempts to other accounts. Attackers can submit sign_in_token_resend with a victim's user[email] parameter, then guess the unthrottled 6-character token to sign in as inactive accounts lacking two-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-118898
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in lasp-lang partisan allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to abort the Erlang VM of a node via Excessive Allocation. partisan_peer_service_server:handle_info/2 decodes every frame that arrives on the peer listener with binary_to_term/1, without the safe option, before handle_inbound/2 interprets the message and before any peer authentication takes place. TLS is off by default and the listener accepts connections from any host, so one frame that names more atoms than the atom table holds aborts the VM. partisan_peer_service_client:handle_inf…

items.title: CVE-2026-136626
items.summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SrsRtcpCommon::decode and SrsRtcpTWCC::decode that lets remote WebRTC peers write past the fixed 1500-byte payload_ array. Unauthenticated attackers opening a WHIP or WHEP session can send oversized BYE, APP, unknown-type or TWCC RTCP packets to overwrite up to 64 KB of heap memory, crashing the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134648
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a header directive injection vulnerability in sendmail/autoreply.pl that allows unauthenticated mail senders to inject autoreply directives by placing them in inbound subject, from, date, or body fields. Attackers can inject Reply-Tracking to delete files at chosen paths, Autoreply-File to exfiltrate files readable by the delivery user, or arbitrary reply headers including To.

items.title: CVE-2026-134644
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134642
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134447
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in postfix/view_mailq.cgi and sendmail/view_mailq.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via unsanitized MIME attachment filenames. Attackers can send a message with a crafted Content-Disposition or Content-Type filename that remains queued, executing script in the Webmin session of users viewing it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134340
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Servers Index module that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to inject scripts via the realhost field of UDP discovery replies. Attackers on the same broadcast domain can answer discovery scans with HTML or JavaScript stored by find_servers() and rendered unescaped by edit_serv.cgi, executing in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134336
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts by submitting malicious failed-login usernames. Attackers can repeatedly submit crafted usernames until blocked, executing script in administrator sessions viewing edit_blocked.cgi in Webmin or Usermin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134328
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mailboxes/detach.cgi that allows unauthenticated mail senders to bypass the HTML sanitizer. Attackers can send HTML attachments with entity-obfuscated javascript: schemes or encoded script tags in iframe srcdoc to execute script in the Webmin session of users opening them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134304
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in apache/restart.cgi that displays the last five Apache ErrorLog lines without HTML escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can inject script into error_log via malformed requests or denied paths, executing in a Webmin user's session when Apache fails to restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-136630
items.summary: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-136622
items.summary: WeKan before 12.78 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Exporter.buildStream() that lets attackers retrieve checklists from other boards by supplying a checklistId export scope. Users able to export any board, or unauthenticated users via a public board, can read private checklists, their items and creator usernames even when anonymization is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-128856
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the file paths, extensions or contents written by one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to write arbitrary PHP files to a web-accessible directory and execute code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-128855

items.title: CVE-2024-4577: PHP code execution via argument injection in CGI (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's CGI module, used with Apache on Windows, is affected when the system uses certain code pages. An attacker could exploit this to pass unintended options to the PHP binary, potentially exposing script source code or running arbitrary PHP code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2022-33891: Apache Spark OS command injection in web UI (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Spark, a widely used open-source data processing framework, is affected when its web UI has access control lists enabled and an authentication filter in use. An attacker could exploit this flaw to run arbitrary operating system commands with the same privileges as the Spark process, potentially taking full control of the affected server.

items.title: CVE-2024-3273: D-Link DNS-320L remote command execution in nas_sharing.cgi (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Attackers can run their own commands on D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L and DNS-340L network storage devices by sending a crafted web request to the nas_sharing.cgi page, remotely and without logging in. These models are no longer supported by the vendor, and the flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0543: Debian redis sandbox escape in Lua scripting enables code execution (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Debian's packaged build of Redis, the key-value database, has a flaw that lets an attacker escape the Lua sandbox and run arbitrary shell commands, reachable remotely without logging in by someone who can run Lua code in Redis. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure server-side request forgery in relay LDAP sync check (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. N-able MailAssure's relay LDAP synchronisation connection check does not restrict its destination, which enables a server-side request forgery flaw. An attacker who can log in with high-level access can reach it remotely over the network to make the server connect to internal hosts and ports, find which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-135768
items.summary: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.

items.summary: The fix for CVE-2026-109449 made the expression parser check the nesting level of long expressions. This check exists since Symfony 5.4.54, 6.4.48, 7.4.21 and 8.1.9. items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-132145
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When using the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) output module (omdtls) configured to authenticate receivers by name or fingerprint, the module validates the certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities but fails to verify that the certificate matches the intended receiver's identity or fingerprint. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.

A Webmin user with broader Users and Groups rights can store a home path containing script via save_user.cgi, executing it in a restricted sub-administrator's Webmin session.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in the SMTP service monitor that never issues STARTTLS because get_smtp_status tests an undefined $ssl variable. Passive network attackers can capture AUTH PLAIN credentials sent in plaintext each time a STARTTLS-configured monitor runs, without needing a Webmin login.

items.title: CVE-2026-134645
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in proc/trace.cgi that allows local unprivileged OS users to inject markup via unescaped process arguments and system call parameters. Attackers can craft process command lines or file names passed to open so that script executes in a Webmin user's session when they trace the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134641
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in minecraft/save_backup.cgi that allows local attackers with write access to the Minecraft server directory to inject script via unescaped world directory names. Attackers can create a world directory containing HTML or script that executes in a Webmin user's session when they run Backup Now.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a STARTTLS downgrade vulnerability in send_mail in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl that continues over plaintext when STARTTLS is rejected. Man-in-the-middle attackers can strip or reject STARTTLS to capture configured SMTP AUTH credentials, crackable CRAM-MD5 exchanges, and the content of sent mail.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak randomness vulnerability that allows attackers to predict TOTP two-factor secrets generated by generate_base32_secret() using a time and PID seeded rand(). Attackers who know a user's password and estimate enrollment time can enumerate candidate seeds, reproduce the secret, and bypass the second authentication factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134635
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-134634
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in servers/link.cgi that accepts self-signed certificates for linked servers even when certificate checking is enabled. Man-in-the-middle attackers presenting a self-signed certificate with the correct hostname can capture stored HTTP Basic credentials for the remote Webmin and inject HTML into the local Webmin origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134633
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in init/mass_systemd.cgi that prints unescaped journalctl output when a systemd service fails to start. Attackers can inject script into the journal via logger or sshd invalid user names, executing it in an administrator's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134631
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit_user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened in the editor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134629
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/index.cgi that renders MySQL connection error text and server version strings without escaping. Malicious MySQL server operators or on-path attackers on plaintext connections can return markup in error packets or version strings to execute JavaScript in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134628
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Disk Quotas module that allows directory administrators to inject markup via NSS user names. Attackers who can create or rename LDAP, NIS or SSSD identities owning blocks on XFS quota filesystems can execute script in the browser of administrators viewing quota/list_users.cgi.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows local users or directory writers to inject script by placing markup in user names, group names or GECOS fields. Attackers can set GECOS via chfn or modify LDAP, NIS or SSSD entries so unescaped values in my_user_chooser.cgi, my_group_chooser.cgi, user_chooser.cgi and group_chooser.cgi execute in a Webmin user's browser.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch_smtp_to_ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mount/nfs_export.cgi that allows malicious NFS servers to inject scripts through unescaped export paths. Attackers controlling or spoofing an NFS server's mountd replies can return crafted export paths that execute JavaScript in the session of a Webmin user browsing exports.

When the non-default random_password option is enabled and administrators keep the pre-filled password in edit_user.cgi, attackers can enumerate time and PID seeds to recover passwords and authenticate as new accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134445
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit_mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

Passive network attackers observing traffic between Webmin and a remote LDAP server can capture directory root credentials because the connection loop always reaches a plaintext bind attempt.

items.title: CVE-2026-134441
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Upload and Download module that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped HTTP status lines from background downloads. Attackers controlling a download server can return a malicious status line stored by updown/download.pl and printed unescaped by updown/index.cgi, executing script in a higher-privileged user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134440
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a Perl code injection vulnerability in cluster-useradmin/sync.cgi that allows attackers to run code by placing single quotes in home directory paths. Attackers with root on one managed host can craft a home path that breaks out of remote_eval() string literals during Sync, executing Perl as root on other managed hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134438
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure download vulnerability in webmin/upgrade.cgi, cluster-webmin/upgrade.cgi and cluster-usermin/upgrade.cgi that fetches upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP with GnuPG signature verification disabled by default. On-path network attackers can substitute a malicious RPM, Debian or tar.gz package during a default upgrade to execute code as root on the Webmin host and managed cluster servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134437
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-server/edit_browser.cgi that allows attackers with write access to LDAP entry attributes to inject script by storing markup in attribute values. When an administrator browses the entry in the LDAP Server directory browser, the unencoded script runs in the Webmin origin, letting attackers act with the administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134368
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in lpadmin/list_jobs.cgi that allows local users or network IPP clients to inject script via CUPS print-job titles. Attackers can submit a print job with a crafted title, for example using lp -t, to execute script in a Printer Administration user's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134333
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/view_table.cgi that allows MySQL users to inject scripts via unescaped column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privilege can create columns containing HTML payloads that execute in a Webmin administrator's session when the table is viewed.

items.title: CVE-2026-134326
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134323
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in generic_ldap_connect in ldap-client-lib.pl that accepts any LDAPS or StartTLS server certificate. Man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate the LDAP server to capture the bind DN password, often the root DN, and return forged directory data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134305
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/raw.cgi that allows attackers with LDAP attribute write access to inject markup. Attackers can store script in user or group attributes or the dn, which executes in an administrator's browser when viewing the raw entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-134283
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http_download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136632
items.summary: OpenProject 17.2.0 before 17.5.2, 17.6.0 before 17.6.1, 17.7.0 before 17.7.3, 17.8.0 before 17.8.2, and 17.9.0 before 17.9.7 contains an externally controlled method selection vulnerability in InplaceEditFieldsController via the unvalidated attribute parameter. Users who can view a project can request the inplace_edit_fields reset route with attribute destroy to delete projects and subprojects, or invoke other methods exposing restricted data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136629
items.summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.95 contains an argument injection vulnerability in readProjectArgsFile and projectFlag that allows malicious repositories to bypass the untrusted project .actrc flag allowlist. Attackers can commit a crafted .actrc smuggling disallowed flags like -P self-hosted or --privileged to run workflow steps on the developer's host.

items.title: CVE-2026-136625
items.summary: ai-memory 2.6.0 before 3.3.2 contains a symlink following vulnerability in the ai-memory-wikisync companion that allows local attackers to overwrite arbitrary files by planting symlinks at predictable temporary names. Attackers can place a .wikisync-tmp-.md symlink in a shared destination so atomic_write() truncates and overwrites its target with the victim's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-136621
items.summary: LTplus-AG ifc-lite @ifc-lite/export before 4.13.1 and ifc-lite-export before 27.0.0 contain a STEP record injection vulnerability in the mutation writer via unescaped typed-value type names. Attackers controlling the mutations payload can place parentheses, semicolons, and newlines in typed.type to append arbitrary entity records to exported IFC files, bypassing the class-name guard.

items.title: CVE-2026-136620
items.summary: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136619
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows shared-list collaborators to learn other users' private favourited and archived bookmark state through filter queries. Viewer or editor collaborators can call bookmarks.getBookmarks on a shared list with favourited or archived set to true, inferring owners' private flags from which bookmarks buildCommonFilters returns.

items.title: CVE-2026-136618
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in ManualList.mergeInto that allows list owners to retain collaborator bookmarks by merging shared lists without ownership checks. Owners invoking the lists.merge tRPC procedure create rows not tied to collaborator membership, preserving read access to collaborator bookmarks and assets after the collaborator's access is revoked.

items.title: CVE-2026-136617
items.summary: Shopify async-memcached before 0.11.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in Client::validate_meta_flags that allows attackers to inject extra memcached meta protocol tokens via whitespace in flags. Attackers controlling part of a meta flag can add quiet, opaque, mode or size override tokens to alter operations and desynchronize responses on shared connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-136616
items.summary: COVESA Open1722 before 0.9.8 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Avtp_Vss_CalcVssPathLength in src/avtp/acf/custom/Vss.c, which reads the INTEROP path-length prefix without checking the declared ACF message length. Attackers can send header-only 12-byte INTEROP-mode VSS frames to trigger reads past the buffer, or prefix values 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF that wrap uint16 lengths and cause Avtp_Vss_SetVssData to overwrite the path area.

items.title: CVE-2026-136615
items.summary: league/commonmark 2.6.0 before 2.10.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in DelimiterStack::push() that miscounts delimiter runs against the max_delimiters_per_line budget. Attackers submitting Markdown with two long emphasis character runs can produce deeply nested strong elements, causing quadratic rendering time and CPU exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-136451
items.summary: A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator. Deterministic hashes derived from Kubernetes Secrets are published in generated StatefulSet metadata and in KeycloakOIDCClient status. A user with read access to those resources may be able to recover a low-entropy credential referenced by a Secret, even when Kubernetes RBAC denies the user access to the Secret itself.

items.title: CVE-2026-136448
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Uploads::saveFile/Auth::init of the file src/Uploads.php of the component Authorization Subsystem. Such manipulation of the argument PicoContentEditorUpload leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases.…

items.title: CVE-2026-124606
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability in Cosminexus Component Container. This issue affects Cosminexus Component Container: from 11-20 before 11-70-04.

items.title: CVE-2026-136447
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in browser-use 0.13.13/0.13.14. This impacts the function load_and_migrate_config of the file browser_use/config.py of the component SecurityWatchdog. The manipulation results in improper authorization. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-135813
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. A privileged user inside a guest virtual machine could use this flaw to make the host QEMU process copy parts of its own memory into the guest's memory, where the attacker could read it. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.

items.title: CVE-2026-136446
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. This affects the function update of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. The manipulation leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-132074
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check that the user has permission to edit the targeted post before switching which editor's content is rendered for it, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to change what any post or page displays, by switching it between its normal content and its stored page builder content.

items.title: CVE-2026-132048
items.summary: The WP Meta SEO WordPress plugin through 4.5.18 does not check that the user is allowed to edit the post or comment containing an indexed link before rewriting or removing that link, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to change the target and text of links in, or strip links from, any post or comment.

items.title: CVE-2026-132047
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check capabilities or nonces in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to read, add, overwrite and delete the builder's saved sections, and to store arbitrary HTML that is rendered unescaped to an administrator who opens a crafted link.

items.title: CVE-2026-132046
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not sanitise and escape some of its layout settings before outputting them in pages, and does not check that the user may edit the post being saved, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to inject stored Cross-Site Scripting payloads into any post or page, including ones they cannot edit.

items.title: CVE-2026-136550
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. This affects the function fromAdvSetMacMtuWan of the file /goform/AdvSetMacMtuWan. This manipulation of the argument mac causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136549

The manipulation of the argument remoteIp results in command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-126536
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX tax-import workflow. An authenticated Manager can import HTML in a tax name and associate the tax with an item. When an Administrator attempts to disable that tax, Akaunting renders the original stored name in an error notification through Vue v-html, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute within the browser of another authenticated user.

items.title: CVE-2026-136146

items.title: CVE-2026-136614
items.summary: GNU Inetutils talkd Stack-based Buffer Overflow Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of GNU Inetutils. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of announce requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-291…

items.title: CVE-2026-130336
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection') in the HWBridge custom methods command dispatcher (lib/rex/post/hwbridge/ui/console/command_dispatcher/custom_methods.rb) in Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 on all platforms allows a malicious or compromised hardware bridge to execute arbitrary code in the msfconsole process via a crafted method_name returned by the /custom_methods endpoint. The injected code runs automatically when the operator connects to the bridge, without the operator invoking any custom command.

items.summary: Wails before 2.17.1 on Linux contains an origin validation error in the sendMessageToBackend WebKitGTK handler that allows child-frame scripts to invoke the privileged IPC channel. Attackers controlling content loaded in an iframe can post messages that pass the top-level URI origin check and call bound Go methods and Wails runtime operations.

items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Netis WF2409E up to 20261026. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/skk_set.cgi of the component CGI Interface. items.title: CVE-2026-123626
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the company localisation date format. An authenticated Manager can store an arbitrary date format. When another authenticated user opens a recurring invoice, Akaunting formats dates with that value and sends the result to a raw HTML schedule description, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-129839
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. An attacker who can supply logged input can exploit this issue to generate malformed JSON output, which may cause downstream log ingestion systems and parsers to reject log records.

items.title: CVE-2026-129832
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When process identification (PID) rewriting is enabled in the imuxsock module, a local attacker with access to the logging socket can send a crafted log message with an empty tag. This triggers an invalid memory write, causing the logging service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-136536
items.summary: LiteLLM is_request_body_safe Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the api_base parameter in chat completion requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29838.

items.title: CVE-2026-136540
items.summary: LiteLLM Secret Manager oidc Resolver Information Disclosure Vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the secret resolution handler. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied input prior to using it to access environment variables. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-31482.

items.title: CVE-2026-136537
items.summary: LiteLLM key_management_endpoints Missing Authorization Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass security features on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the key_management_endpoints module. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. Was ZDI-CAN-32342.

items.title: CVE-2026-16665
items.summary: Summary MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation paths using assert(). items.title: CVE-2026-61513
items.summary: VeraCrypt through 1.26.31 on Linux contains an improper path restriction vulnerability in the elevated CoreService, which passes the path and owner UID from a SetFileOwnerRequest directly to chown() in CoreUnix::SetFileOwner without target validation on Linux. An attacker with an active elevated CoreService session and same-UID access who reopens the request pipe through /proc//fd/ can take ownership of arbitrary system files such as /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow, achieving full root compromise.

items.title: CVE-2026-136421
items.summary: rocket.chat Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of rocket.chat. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the web service, which listens on TCP port 3000 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-29853.

items.title: CVE-2026-61512

Attackers can reopen the request pipe through /proc//fd/ and supply a crafted VirtualDevice value such as /dev/null; to achieve arbitrary command execution as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-132260
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.4.2 before 0.11.0, the E2B code-execution blocks ExecuteCodeBlock, InstantiateCodeSandboxBlock, and ClaudeCodeBlock can leave sandboxes running on the operator's shared E2B credential for up to the sandbox's full timeout, while users are billed only for the block's run time. Any user with a positive credit balance can keep sandboxes running for up to 24 hours on a Pro plan for a flat 1 credit, and each run adds another sandbox. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-132256
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the format Jinja filter in TextFormatter accepts an unbounded width. An authenticated user who can author or run a workflow, or supply its input, can trigger a single synchronous multi-gigabyte allocation that exhausts the executor worker's memory and degrades or denies execution for other users. There is no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

Outputs are also biased: the first digit after the decimal point is never zero, so rand(256) never returns 1 to 24. An attacker who sees three consecutive outputs can predict the tokens, passwords or key bytes that the same object later issues to…

items.title: CVE-2026-129969

items.title: CVE-2026-136328
items.summary: A flaw was found in the file-psd plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted PSD (Photoshop Document) image file in LAB color mode, the plugin does not properly validate that a fourth channel is present when the transparency flag is set. This mismatch causes the merged-image path to allocate buffers for three components while performing color conversion with four-component formats, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

items.summary: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to trigger excessive looping by advertising an undersized AU-headers-length. Attackers can send a crafted 22-byte AAC-hbr RTP packet from an RTP sender or malicious RTSP server to run about 2^28 iterations, pinning a CPU core and stalling clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-136195
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to crash clients by sending MP4V-ES RTP payloads shorter than 4 bytes. A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136194
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-136193
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the STAP-A handling of gf_rtp_parse_h264 in rtp_depacketizer.c due to unchecked aggregation unit sizes. A malicious RTP sender or RTSP server can send STAP-A packets with oversized NAL unit lengths to disclose adjacent heap memory or crash the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-136192
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-136191
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in gf_rtsp_do_deinterleave that allows malicious RTSP servers to hang clients by sending non-RTSP, non-interleaved data. Attackers can answer a client request with a few bytes not starting with '$', 'RTSP', or 'HTTP', causing the RTSP client thread to spin forever and consume a full CPU core.

Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.

items.title: CVE-2026-135787 — CVSS 5.3
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in hrshadhin CloudSchool up to 3.0.1. Affected is the function ReportController::marksheetPublic of the component Captcha Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument authorized_form results in improper authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-122093
items.summary: Strong::Random versions through 0.96 for Perl allow every later rand output to be predicted from three earlier ones. The generator keeps its state in a single number. Each call multiplies the state by a factor derived from it, and the returned digits encode that factor, so three consecutive outputs determine the state however the generator was seeded. Outputs are also biased: the first digit after the decimal point is never zero, so rand256 never returns 1 to 24. An attacker who sees three consecutive outputs can predict the tokens, passwords or key bytes that the same object later issues to o…

items.title: Webworm APT Slithers Into Networks With Customized SoftEther VPN
items.summary: The China-aligned espionage group rebuilt the open source VPN software from source, stripping out the artifacts that would normally expose it to defenders.

items.title: Stop Calling it PCI: A Risk-First Approach to Compliance (Ep. 17)
items.summary: How do you make PCI DSS compliance part of everyday security instead of a separate burden?
