Chapters: 00:00 What is a firewall? 00:19 Simon Turner’s path into PCI 02:11 Using PCI DSS alongside other standards 04:30 How analysis shapes a security program 05:44 Security education for sm…

items.title: seccomp-tools
items.summary: Seccomp Tools Powerful tools for seccomp analysis. This project is aimed primarily but not exclusively at analyzing seccomp sandboxes in CTF pwn challenges. Some features are CTF-specific, but they're just as useful for analyzing real-world seccomp filters. Features Dump - Automatically dumps seccomp BPF from executables. Disasm - Converts seccomp BPF to a human-readable format. With simple decompilation. With syscall names and arguments whenever possible. Colorful! Asm - Makes writing seccomp rules as easy as writing code. Emu - Emulates seccomp rules. Explain - Summarizes a filter as a per-a…

items.title: ttu-iam 0.1.2
items.summary: Official Python SDK for TTU IAM: OIDC/SSO, PKCE, access/ID token verify, map_subject, and Flask/FastAPI integrations

items.title: DrupalのCVE-2026-132165、実際の悪用を確認。AnthropicのAIが発見
items.summary: Drupalの重大な脆弱性が実際のWebサイトで悪用された。AnthropicのOSS Scannerが発見した。米当局CISAは既知の悪用された脆弱性カタログ（KEV）に追加し、対象の連邦政府機関に侵害の有無を調べる初期調査も求めている。

items.title: VMware Workstation・FusionのCVE-2026-123912、ホスト側のコード実行リスク
items.summary: VMware WorkstationとFusionの重大な脆弱性が公表された。仮想マシン内の管理者権限が悪用されるとホスト側でコードが実行されるおそれがある。修正版の26H1u1は仮想マシンが停止するおそれのある脆弱性にも対処している。

items.title: Claudeで作ったアプリをWindows・macOSにインストール、全プラン向けにベータ提供
items.summary: AnthropicはClaudeが生成したアプリをWindowsとmacOSにインストールできる機能のベータ提供を開始した。独立したウィンドウで動作し、許可に応じて通知やファイル操作も可能になる。

items.title: Rackspace Spot、セキュリティ侵害を受け12月9日にサービス終了へ
items.summary: 米クラウド事業者RackspaceがRackspace Spotの提供終了を決めた。日本時間12月9日午前8時に稼働中の処理を停止する予定で、利用者はデータの退避と移行に加え、漏えいの恐れがある認証情報への対応を求められている。

items.title: EU、量子技術法案を発表。投資基金の設立と耐量子暗号への移行を提案
items.summary: 欧州委員会が量子技術法案を発表した。加盟国の研究・産業支援を連携させ、量子技術やAIなどに投資する新基金の設立を目指す。量子コンピュータの開発を促すとともに、その進歩に備えた耐量子暗号への移行を公共調達でも進める案を示した。

items.title: Todoistに不正アクセス、採用終了後も残った旧方式のパスワードハッシュが流出
items.summary: タスク管理サービスのTodoistで顧客情報が流出した。旧式のSHA-1によるパスワードハッシュに加え、外部サービスとの連携も影響を受けた。Todoistは旧方式への対応を廃止し、対象者に認証情報の再設定などを案内している。

items.title: アイオーデータ、法人向けNAS「HDL-LH」を発表。物理ボタンで管理画面を保護
items.summary: アイオーデータが法人向けNASの最上位モデルHDL-LHシリーズを発表した。本体のボタン操作を管理画面へのログイン条件にでき、ファイル共有向けにはLAN DISK初のSMBアカウントロックを搭載する。

items.title: タイムズカー情報漏洩、見舞金3000円の受け取り方法を発表。12月1日から順次案内
items.summary: タイムズカーの見舞金は、暗号化された本人確認書類の画像へのアクセスと外部送信の痕跡が確認された利用者が対象。対象の現会員は現金3000円か同額のカーシェアeチケットを選べる。対象の退会者と入会未完了者には現金を支払う。

items.title: 楽天証券、個人情報約441万件の漏洩を発表。口座未開設者の情報も約119万件
items.summary: 楽天証券が追加調査で確認した個人情報の漏洩は約441万件。実際の預かり資産残高も対象に含まれ、口座開設の申し込みをして開設に至らなかった人の情報も約119万件に及ぶ。

items.title: Firefox 161公開。通常ウィンドウに閲覧データ消去ボタンを順次導入、VPNはサイト別制御に
items.summary: MozillaはFirefox 161でデスクトップ版の通常の閲覧ウィンドウにもデータ消去ボタンを順次導入する。デスクトップ版の内蔵VPNは全体の設定にかかわらずサイトごとに使用の有無を指定できるようになった。

items.title: ファーウェイ、米国の刑事裁判で有罪。イランへの制裁違反と米企業からの技術窃取を認定
items.summary: 米国時間2026年11月24日、ニューヨークの連邦陪審が華為技術（ファーウェイ）と子会社3社に有罪の評決を下した。12件の罪状のうち10件で有罪。量刑は2027年9月に予定されている。

items.title: AIエージェントは出口を見つけたとき何をするか。Anthropicが1700超のシナリオで測定した結果
items.summary: Anthropicは米国時間11月24日、AIエージェントがサンドボックスの境界を守るかどうかを測る評価手法「Siren」の詳細を公開した。意図的に隔離を不完全にした環境でタスクを与え、モデルが何をするかを観察する。

items.title: Roundcube 1.6.22・1.7.7公開、1.6系のセキュリティ更新は今回が最後
items.summary: オープンソースのWebメールソフトウェアRoundcubeが暗号化通信や添付ファイル処理などの脆弱性を修正した。1.6.22は長期サポート版1.6系の最終リリースで、開発元は1.7系への速やかな移行を求めている。

items.title: How to compare MDR providers when every proposal looks promising
items.summary: Choosing a managed detection and response (MDR) provider means committing budget, connecting systems, and trusting another team to act when your organization is under pressure. Yet a proposal promising 24x7 coverage, expert analysts, and fast response can leave important questions unanswered. Which systems will actually be monitored? What will analysts investigate before contacting you? What happens when an incident needs more work? Before choosing a provider or renewing your current agreement, ask for evidence of how the service operates. Rapid7’s MDR Evaluation Scorecard gives you 18 checks…

items.title: Maple Disruption 2.0 aftermath: Hosting providers enabling phishing and fraud targeting Canadians
items.summary: From November 2 to 6, 2026, Spamhaus attended Maple Disruption 2.0 organized by Canadian law enforcement, gathering representatives from government agencies, financial sector and cybersecurity organizations to combat fraud and cybercrime. In this blog post, we share some of our findings and recommendations.

items.title: Introducing context-aware rules for AWS Network Firewall
items.summary: AWS Network Firewall now supports context-aware rules, which match traffic by the AWS resources that send and receive it instead of by IP address. A rule can name a virtual private cloud (VPC), a subnet, a security group, or a transit gateway attachment. Rules that match on IP addresses have to keep up with every […]

items.title: Introducing AWS Network Firewall Next Generation policy

They want to allow only the traffic each application needs, and they want each allowed connection checked for known threats. Today, you can do both with AWS Network Firewall, a stateful, managed network firewall and intrusion detection and prevention […]

items.title: Cisco and OpenAI dispatch AI agents to shield vulnerable systems before permanent patches arrive
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents are rapidly and dramatically transforming the cybersecurity landscape for both defenders and adversaries. In hopes of giving security teams a head start and pitting machine against machine, Cisco and OpenAI have released a new open source project, dubbed Shirudo (Japanese for “shield”). The Shirudo platform launches small, temporary mitigations to help protect systems until patches can be deployed. AI agents can replace flawed code with fixed code, which human teams can test and approve (or not), then deploy, setting boundaries and holding onto the keys, with no need for a…

items.title: Prompting AI to be ‘thorough’ can drive sandbox escapes, Anthropic says
items.summary: Prompt wording meant to make AI agents more resourceful, such as telling them to search thoroughly or invoking authority, sharply raises the odds they will reach outside a poorly secured sandbox, Anthropic has found in its latest evaluation. The evaluation, called Siren, gives Claude models routine dev-ops tasks inside deliberately weakened sandboxes and places a “honeypot,” such as a credential, file, or emulated internet service, outside the boundary, Anthropic researchers Oscar O’Rahilly and Darya Kaviani wrote in a blog post . Anthropic tested six Claude models, from Mythos 5 to the 5.5 se…

items.summary: Almost half of the money taken from UK bank accounts through fraud in the first half of this year was authorised by the victims themselves, according to figures from UK Finance. items.title: Pop!_OS 26.04
items.summary: Pop!_OS is an Ubuntu-based Linux distribution featuring its own GNOME-based desktop environment called COSMIC. It is designed with productivity in mind; it has fluid windows, search navigation via the Super key, workspaces that can hide clutter, and efficient auto-tiling of windows. The distribution is developed by US-based Linux computer retailer System76.

items.title: RELIANOID 9.0.1
items.summary: RELIANOID is a Debian-based Linux distribution for load balancing. The project offers a specialist operating system for testing, development and quality assurance environments. Relianoid is available in Community (free of cost) and Enterprise editions.

items.title: Nebula 2026.11.24
items.summary: Nebula Linux is a set of two distinct Linux distributions for the desktop based either on Debian's "Stable" branch or on Arch Linux, with the former featuring a vanilla KDE Plasma desktop, while the latter, a rolling-release variant, integrating the DankMaterialShell (DMS) desktop shell on top of the niri Wayland compositor. Some of the features of Nebula Linux include out-of-the-box support for Flatpak packages, a custom Nebula Welcome app, a branded Calamares system installer, a separate command-line installation option, and support for Btrfs snapshots and rollbacks integrated into the GRUB…

items.title: Br OS 13.8
items.summary: Br OS is a Brazilian Linux distribution based on Debian and featuring the KDE Plasma desktop. It is designed as an intuitive, easy-to-use, general-purpose operating system for web navigation and content creation, providing a selection of useful applications for daily use.

items.title: StormOS 2026.11
items.summary: StormOS is a desktop-oriented Linux distribution based on Arch Linux. The project's goal is to build an operating system which is easy-to-install, beginner-friendly and usable out of the box in order to attract new users over to the world of Arch Linux.

items.title: NCSC-2026-0515 [1.00] [M/H] Kwetsbaarheid verholpen in OTRS
items.summary: OTRS heeft een kwetsbaarheid verholpen in de Survey endpoint van versies 2024.3.1 tot en met 2026.8.1. De kwetsbaarheid betreft een SQL-injectie in de Survey endpoint, waardoor ongeauthenticeerde externe aanvallers willekeurige SQL-queries kunnen injecteren. Dit gebeurt zonder dat authenticatie of een geldige survey key vereist is. Door misbruik van deze kwetsbaarheid kan een aanvaller ticketinformatie opvragen en gevoelige data uit de backend database extraheren. Dit beïnvloedt de integriteit en vertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens in het ticketingsysteem.

items.title: California privacy agency director Kemp to leave after two-year tenure
items.summary: The director of the trailblazing California Privacy Protection Agency announced his departure following implementation of a first-in-the-nation platform allowing consumers to easily opt out of data sharing.

items.title: Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cybersecurity incident
items.summary: The Treasury Department has taken some systems offline after a cyberattack after a cybersecurity incident which “resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems.”

items.title: How We Eliminated the 44ms Chrome WebCodecs AAC Priming Offset in Pure JavaScript
items.summary: When we built Audio Visualizer Online — a zero-upload browser studio that renders 1080p audio-reactive MP4 music videos at 4–5× real time using Canvas 2D , WebCodecs ( VideoEncoder + AudioEncoder ), and mp4-muxer — everything looked crisp in our first lab tests. items.summary: As organizations accelerate AI adoption, a new security challenge is emerging: AI Agent Collisions. Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents are increasingly operating across business applications, accessing sensitive data, invoking APIs, and taking actions on behalf of users and organizations. Without visibility into which agents exist, what they can access, and how they interact, organizations risk creating unintended access paths, conflicting actions, data exposure, and gaps in security oversight. James Robinson, CISO at Netskope, joins Business Security Weekly to explore the emerging problem…
